text:
Type: wood veneer wall shelf with metal brackets
Use: holding books, plants and decor above a desk or sofa; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: birch veneer board, brushed aluminium brackets
Colors: light natural birch, silver grey
Shape: long thin board clamped at each end by slim angular metal brackets screwed to the wall, straight edges, light and floating, low visual weight
Feel: light, tidy, airy, fresh
Goes with: light wood, white walls, steel or chrome accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern home offices

product.name: EKBY JRPEN,EKBY BJRNUM
product.description: As the bracket covers the edge of the shelf; you can cut the shelf without the cut edge showing.
